description: Reviewer dashboard, human review queue, compliance export, and labeled dataset pipeline. This covers the human-in-the-loop systems: a reviewer dashboard built with shadcn/ui showing flagged conversations with full context, one-click classification (true positive/false positive/escalate), and the compliance export system that produces regulator-grade audit reports. Also includes the labeled dataset pipeline that stores reviewer decisions tied to original content for future model tuning.
steps: Create shadcn/ui component foundation: Install and configure shadcn/ui CLI. Add core components: Button, Card, Badge, Table, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Input, Textarea, Select, Tabs, Avatar, Separator, ScrollArea, Alert, Toast. Create src/components/ui/ directory with all components.

Create src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx: Authenticated dashboard layout with sidebar navigation (Overview, Review Queue, Conversations, Settings, Compliance, Billing), user avatar/role display, client context indicator for multi-tenant. Protect with NextAuth session check.

Create src/app/(dashboard)/review/page.tsx: Review queue page showing flagged conversations. Table/list view with columns: severity badge (critical/high/medium), category (self-harm/sexual/age-inappropriate/escalation), conversation snippet, timestamp flagged, assigned reviewer, status. Filters: by severity, category, status (pending/in-review/resolved), date range. Sort by priority (critical first, then by time).

Create src/app/(dashboard)/review/[flagId]/page.tsx: Detailed review view for a single flagged conversation. Shows: full conversation history with the flagged turn highlighted, all scores (turn-level and arc-level) visualized, what specific patterns/rules triggered the flag, suggested action, and the classification form. Classification options: True Positive (confirmed risk - action was appropriate), False Positive (not actually risky - improve detection), Escalate (needs senior review or action beyond current scope). Notes field for reviewer context. Assign-to-reviewer dropdown.

Create API routes for the review system: src/app/api/v1/reviews/route.ts (GET - list review items with filters, RBAC: REVIEWER or ADMIN), src/app/api/v1/reviews/[reviewId]/route.ts (GET - detail, PATCH - update status/assignment), src/app/api/v1/reviews/[reviewId]/decide/route.ts (POST - submit classification decision with notes). All decisions logged to audit trail. Decision creates a LabeledDataEntry automatically.

Create src/lib/labeled-dataset/pipeline.ts: When a reviewer makes a classification decision, automatically create a LabeledDataEntry containing: the original turn content, all scores at time of flag, the arc context (surrounding turns), the reviewer's decision (true_positive/false_positive/escalate), reviewer notes, a version number. This is the training data pipeline - structured for future model fine-tuning. Include export function that produces versioned JSONL format suitable for ML training.

Create src/app/api/v1/labeled-data/route.ts: GET endpoint to export labeled dataset for a client (ADMIN only). Supports JSONL format with versioning. Includes metadata about the scoring model version that produced the original scores.

Create src/app/(dashboard)/compliance/page.tsx: Compliance export page. Client admin can generate reports for specified time periods. Report types: Full Audit Log (all events), Incident Report (flags + actions + outcomes), Response Time Report (time from flag to action/resolution), Review Outcomes Summary (TP/FP rates, categories). Export formats: CSV, PDF (generated server-side).

Create src/app/api/v1/compliance/export/route.ts: POST endpoint to generate compliance exports. Accepts: report_type, date_range, format (csv/json). Returns download URL or streams the file. The export maps to what regulators ask for: timestamped flags, actions taken, response time from flag to action, human review outcomes. Include California SB 243 reporting fields specifically.

Create src/lib/compliance/report-generator.ts: Report generation logic. Queries audit log entries for the client and time period, formats them according to report type. For Incident Reports: groups by incident (flag -> actions -> review -> resolution), calculates response times, includes full conversation context for each incident. CSV format uses headers that map to known regulatory reporting templates.

Write tests for the review API: tests/api/reviews.test.ts - RBAC enforcement (reviewer can access queue, non-reviewer cannot), classification flow (pending -> in_review -> resolved), audit log entries created on every decision, labeled dataset entry created on classification. Write tests for compliance export: tests/lib/compliance/report-generator.test.ts - correct date filtering, correct grouping, response time calculation, CSV format validity.

Write audit log immutability tests in tests/lib/audit/immutability.test.ts: Verify no code path exposes update/delete on audit entries. Verify hash chain integrity checking works. Verify tampered entries are detected. Verify that all review actions produce audit entries.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm test passes all review, compliance, labeled-dataset, and audit immutability tests
Review queue page renders with proper filtering and sorting
Classification decisions are recorded in both ReviewDecision and LabeledDataEntry tables
Compliance export produces valid CSV with correct headers and data
Audit log immutability is enforced - no update/delete operations exist on audit entries
RBAC correctly restricts review actions to REVIEWER and ADMIN roles
All reviewer actions create audit log entries
Labeled dataset export produces valid JSONL with all required fields
